name: owners can put get and list lexicographically ordered object metadata
input: one namespace containing three objects and a key prefix filter
test:
store = ObjectStorageNamespace()
store.create_namespace('team-a', 'ada')
store.put('team-a', 'models/z.txt', 'z', 'ada')
store.put('team-a', 'models/a.txt', 'alpha', 'ada')
store.put('team-a', 'notes.txt', 'memo', 'ada')
assert store.get('team-a', 'models/a.txt', 'ada') == 'alpha'
assert store.list_objects('team-a', 'ada') == [
    {'key': 'models/a.txt', 'size': 5},
    {'key': 'models/z.txt', 'size': 1},
    {'key': 'notes.txt', 'size': 4},
]
assert store.list_objects('team-a', 'ada', 'models/') == [
    {'key': 'models/a.txt', 'size': 5},
    {'key': 'models/z.txt', 'size': 1},
]

name: overwrites and deletes preserve namespace semantics
input: an overwritten object followed by deletion and a missing-key delete
test:
store = ObjectStorageNamespace()
store.create_namespace('n', 'owner')
store.put('n', 'same', 'one', 'owner')
store.put('n', 'same', 'longer', 'owner')
assert store.get('n', 'same', 'owner') == 'longer'
assert store.list_objects('n', 'owner') == [{'key': 'same', 'size': 6}]
assert store.delete('n', 'same', 'owner') is True
assert store.delete('n', 'same', 'owner') is False

name: ownership transfer revokes the old principal immediately
input: a namespace with one object transferred from ada to ben
test:
store = ObjectStorageNamespace()
store.create_namespace('n', 'ada')
store.put('n', 'x', 'value', 'ada')
store.transfer_owner('n', 'ben', 'ada')
for call in (lambda: store.get('n', 'x', 'ada'), lambda: store.put('n', 'y', 'new', 'ada'), lambda: store.delete('n', 'x', 'ada')):
    try:
        call()
        raise AssertionError('expected PermissionError')
    except PermissionError:
        pass
assert store.get('n', 'x', 'ben') == 'value'
store.put('n', 'y', 'new', 'ben')
assert [row['key'] for row in store.list_objects('n', 'ben')] == ['x', 'y']
